title: CMIBL
description: A Minecraft mod featuring land protection, advanced chat, and server management tools.
body:
CMIBl - Ultimate Server Enhancement Mod for Minecraft

Elevate your Minecraft server with this all-in-one solution featuring:

Smart Land Protection - Customizable regions with PvP flags, build permissions, and anti-griefing

Advanced Chat System - Local/global channels, player mentions, private messages, and profanity filters

Boss Mechanics - Custom health scaling and timed Ender Dragon respawns

Performance Tools - Automatic item clearing to reduce lag

UI Customization - Dynamic tablist, formatted messages, and clickable elements

Fully configurable with intuitive settings - perfect for both small communities and large networks!

Why Choose CMIBl?
🔹 Admins: Granular control through simple config files
🔹 Players: Intuitive protection and communication tools
🔹 Servers: Lightweight optimization for better performance

The complete package for RPG, survival, and faction servers!

(Available for Forge - Configurable via in-game commands and config files)

This version:

Uses clean formatting with emoji bullet points

Highlights key technical features

Emphasizes both admin control and player experience

Clearly states compatibility

Maintains professional yet engaging tone
